thread:
evan: Putting together a short thread for action items from the DB failover postmortem. We need clear owners for: status page copy, customer outreach, RCA sharing policy, and the recurring-pattern investigation. Can we confirm ownership now?

maria-p: I can take the status page copy. Plan: one-paragraph summary, two bullets (impact + "what we're doing next"), and an explicit link to request more info. Will avoid internal hostnames. ETA 17:30 UTC.

jamie: Support will assemble the outreach list. We already have 9 customers flagged as potentially impacted; I'll confirm count and tiering by 18:00.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22-DBCASCADE resolved  services restored 02:12 UTC; incident duration ~47m; cause: cross-region failover race. See: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-03-22-DBCASCADE

sachin: I'll draft an RCA-sharing policy. Suggested baseline: "RCA on request" for most incidents, automatic publish only for SEV1/customer-impacting regulatory incidents after redaction. I'll include a small workflow: request -> redaction review -> release. ETA next day 11:00.

legal-sw: Quick note: include a redaction checklist (no internal IPs, no internal SSO tokens, redact customer PII). For enterprise customers, require consent before publishing specifics that mention them. Happy to review final copy.

anya: I'll own the recurring-pattern ticket to track failover-related incidents. Plan: 1) triage existing incidents, 2) propose engineering workstreams (runtime + infra), 3) schedule a 2-week review. Initial summary in 14 days.

evan: Thanks. Let's make sure status page and outreach messaging are aligned. maria-p, please add a small "we'll follow up with affected customers directly" line so support copy matches.

maria-p: Will do. Also adding a "you can request the RCA" CTA with a simple email/link.

jamie: For outreach copy, please give us a 1-paragraph template + optional technical appendix (redacted) for enterprise customers. We'll hold the appendix until legal signs off.

sachin: For the policy doc I'll include two short templates: (A) public summary + request link, (B) full RCA request approval flow.

legal-sw: Add a short timeframe note: if a customer requests full RCA, response within 72 hours for acknowledgement, and aim to provide the redacted doc within 10 business days unless otherwise negotiated. That helps set expectations.

evan: Good. Action list (putting in thread so it's visible):
- maria-p: Draft status page copy by 17:30 UTC
- jamie/support: Outreach list + templates by 18:00 UTC
- legal-sw: Redaction checklist & review by 20:00 UTC
- sachin: RCA-sharing policy + templates by next day 11:00 UTC
- anya: Recurring-pattern investigation owner; initial summary in 14 days

maria-p: ACK. I'll open a PR at /docs/statuspage and tag #eng and #support for review.

jamie: ACK. Will also coordinate a short customer notification schedule to avoid duplicate pings.

sachin: One more thing: recommend adding a short FAQ entry on the status page about "How do I get the full RCA?" with the basic steps. That reduces support noise.

evan: Nice. Also, add the recurring-pattern ticket to the postmortem action tracker and mark it as P2 with an engineering spike.

ops-bot: Reminder: Add action items to postmortem tracker and create calendar invite for the 2-week pattern review (owner: anya).

legal-sw: I'll review the PR when it's ready. If anyone needs help with redaction language, ping me directly.

evan: OK, thanks everyone. If deadlines slip, flag here. Otherwise we'll close this sync once PR + legal pass are complete. :thumbsup:
